messages:
Tess (Infra): Quick follow-up from the all-hands about region sequencing, autoscale defaults, and short-term pricing for cross-region bursts. Posting answers here so it's searchable.

Arjun (SRE): What's the firm order for region rollouts now? APAC timing?

Tess (Infra): Order: US-east primary -> EMEA (late Q2) -> APAC (early Q3). APAC remains conditional on freight windows; will update if partner slot shifts.

Leah (Product): For customers worried about latency, can we expose expected delta in Console when a route is eligible for cross-region burst?

Vik (Runtime): Yes. Console will show "expected p99 delta" (e.g., +60-120ms). Also adding an opt-out toggle for cross-region bursting per-route.

Arjun (SRE): Autoscaler defaults? Any change to buffer thresholds?

Tess (Infra): Default local_buffer=0.12, cross_region_allowed=true, predicted_p99_threshold=170ms. Dedicated customers can override. Canary next Tue.

procure-bot: PO#11234 placed for mixed A100/H100 EMEA buffer. Delivery window 2110170000-2110240000. Rack confirmation needed.

Leah (Product): Action: I'll add a KB on "bursting behavior" + update signup language for EMEA/ APAC.

Vik (Runtime): Note on KV cache: cross-region bursts may miss warm prefixes; recommend enabling prefix cache for chat-heavy routes to reduce cold p99.

Arjun (SRE): Who validates perf when H100s arrive?

Vik (Runtime): I'll run the benchmark suite and publish numbers to the model catalog within 48 hours of hardware readiness.

Tess (Infra): Thanks all. If you have customer-sensitive cases, DM me. Closing thread later today. :wave:
